belay.P1: Stop on the flat ledge at the foot of the vertical crack, once the ramp steps are behind you.
belay.P2: Walk the ledge left to its far end and belay at the trees there.
belay.P3: Belay at the two-bolt anchor reached after the crux finger crack and knobs.
belay.P4: Belay at the anchor on the small ledge at the top of the pitch.
belay.P5: Belay on the narrow ledge above the overhanging flake, at the top of the pitch; the new line heads off right from there.
belay.P6: Belay in a small alcove just to the right of the sharp flake.

belay.1: Belay below the roof that cuts back left, at the top of the long left-facing corner, on pins and gear.
belay.5: Belay in the biggest cave on the wall, at the end of the long horizontal traverse left.
belay.8: Belay at the bolted anchor on the treed ledge reached after the hollow flakes.

belay.1: Hang from the two bolts at the top of the twin cracks, up the right-hand crack.
belay.2: Belay on the ledge with a bolted anchor, above the offset tips crack and its pin.
belay.3: Belay on the broad ledge at the top of the pitch, building a gear anchor.
belay.4: Belay on the ledge above the pillar, on a fixed pin and gear.
belay.5: Belay on the small ledge past the bulge, building a gear anchor with a bolt just to the left.
belay.6: Belay at the bolts at the top of the chimney.

belay.1: Belay at the bolts below the start of the second pitch of the East Wall route.
belay.3: Belay hanging at the top of the widening crack.
belay.4: Belay on a comfortable ledge after the sport finish over the bulge.
belay.7: Step down around the corner from the arete to a ledge; its anchor is not meant for rappelling.
belay.8: Belay at the slackline bolts just over the lip, or go on to the summit.

belay.2: Belay on the small ledge that has a bushy tree.
belay.3: Belay at a horn after angling right past a tree.
belay.4: Belay on blocks next to the huge flake, after the move around the arete onto the ledge.
belay.5: Finish on the spacious ledge after the traverse left to the second thin crack.
belay.6: Belay at the tree below the Hercules Tower.
